The '''''Rabid Nek Dog''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was used by a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Syv Bullnumull]] served aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and she led the rest of the crew in a mutiny against the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[First Mate/Legends|mate]], stranding the pair on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hok/Legends|Hok]]. Afterward, Bullnumull became the new leader of band of smugglers, and the crew soon adapted to her new regime.
